Load required packages
```{r,load packages}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggsignif)
library(MASS)
```

```{r}
rm(list=ls())
combined_data <- readRDS("output/combined_data_activity.rds")
combined_data <- combined_data%>%filter(AgeD!=7)
#combined_data <- combined_data%>%filter(Experiment!="DAMtest")

```
Create summary data across days and experiments
```{r}
avg_counts_by_tube <- combined_data %>%
  group_by(Experiment,Monitor,Tube,Time) %>%
  summarise(Experiment=Experiment,
            Geno=Geno,
            Sex=Sex,
            Time=Time,
            tube_mean = round(mean(Summary_Ct)), 
            tube_sd = round(sd(Summary_Ct))
            )
avg_counts_by_Experiment <- avg_counts_by_tube %>%
  group_by(Experiment,Sex,Time) %>%
  summarise(Experiment=Experiment,
            Geno=Geno,
            Sex=Sex,
            Time=Time,
            experiment_mean = round(mean(tube_mean)), 
            experiment_sd = round(sd(tube_mean))
            )
#avg_counts_by_tube$Time <- format(strptime(avg_counts_by_tube$Time, format = "%H:%M:%S"), format = "%H:%M")
avg_counts_by_tube<-bind_rows(unclass(distinct(avg_counts_by_tube)))
avg_counts_by_Geno <- avg_counts_by_Experiment %>%
  group_by(Sex,Time) %>%
  summarise(Geno=Geno,
            Sex=Sex,
            Time=Time,
            mean = round(mean(experiment_mean)), 
            sd = round(sd(experiment_mean))
            )
#avg_counts_by_Experiment$Time <- format(strptime(avg_counts_by_Experiment$Time, format = "%H:%M:%S"), format = "%H:%M")
avg_counts_by_Experiment<-bind_rows(unclass(distinct(avg_counts_by_Experiment)))

#avg_counts_by_Geno$Time <- format(strptime(avg_counts_by_Geno$Time, format = "%H:%M:%S"), format = "%H:%M")
avg_counts_by_Geno<-bind_rows(unclass(distinct(avg_counts_by_Geno)))
```
Plotting by Sex
```{r}
ggplot(avg_counts_by_tube, aes(x = Time, y = tube_mean, color = Sex, fill = Sex, 
                       group = interaction(Tube, Monitor))) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line() +
  labs(x = "Hour", y = "Mean Count", title = "All Tubes by Sex") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("M" = "purple", "F" = "orange")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("M" = "purple", "F" = "orange")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  facet_wrap(~ Experiment, nrow = 3)

ggplot(avg_counts_by_Experiment, aes(x = Time, y = experiment_mean, color = Sex, fill = Sex,
                                     group = interaction(Sex,Experiment))) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line() +
  labs(x = "Hour", y = "Mean Count", title = "Separate Experiments") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("M" = "purple", "F" = "orange")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("M" = "purple", "F" = "orange")) +
  theme_minimal() 

ggplot(avg_counts_by_Geno, aes(x = Time, y = mean, color = Sex, fill = Sex,                                group=interaction(Sex,Geno))) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - sd, ymax = mean + sd), width = 0.2) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = "00:00", xmax = "09:00", ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
           fill = "darkgray", alpha = 0.5) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = "21:00", xmax = "23:59", ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
           fill = "darkgray", alpha = 0.5) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = "01:00", xmax = "03:00", ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
           fill = "lightblue", alpha = 0.7) +
  annotate("text", x = "02:00", y = Inf,
           label = "Midnight Snack", vjust = 13, color = "black", size = 4)+
  annotate("rect", xmin = "07:00", xmax = "09:00", ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
           fill = "lightpink", alpha = 0.7) +
  annotate("text", x = "08:00", y = Inf,
           label = "Morning Anxiety", vjust = 3, color = "black", size = 4)+
  annotate("rect", xmin = "11:00", xmax = "13:00", ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
           fill = "lightgreen", alpha = 0.7) +
  annotate("text", x = "12:00", y = Inf,
           label = "Early Siesta", vjust = 13, color = "black", size = 4)+
  annotate("rect", xmin = "20:00", xmax = "22:00", ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
           fill = "violet", alpha = 0.7) +
  annotate("text", x = "21:00", y = Inf,
           label = "Evening Peak", vjust = 3, color = "black", size = 4)+
  geom_point() +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    x = "Hour", y = "Mean Counts per Hour",
    title = element_text(
      paste("Canton S Circadian Activity Ages 4-6 days",  # Concatenate the lines
            "\nAveraged across three experiments"),  # Second line of the title
      lineheight = 0.9  # Adjust the line height here (default is 1)
    )
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("M" = "purple", "F" = "orange")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("M" = "purple", "F" = "orange")) +
  theme_classic() + theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))+
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))  # Rotate x-axis labels 45deg
```
Significance Testing for Canton S largest sex differences in Activity levels:
Poisson model
```{r}
combined_data
# Fit Poisson regression model
poisson_model <- glm(tube_mean ~ Sex * Time + Experiment, data = avg_counts_by_tube, family = poisson)

# View model summary
summary(poisson_model)

# Get the summary table as a data frame
summary_df <- as.data.frame(summary(poisson_model)$coefficients)

# Extract the desired columns
summary_df <- summary_df[, c("Estimate", "Std. Error", "z value", "Pr(>|z|)")]

# Rename the columns for clarity
colnames(summary_df) <- c("Estimate", "Std.Error", "z.value", "Pr(>|z|)")
```
Check for overdispersion (this code may need to be tweaked, not tested yet)
```{r}
# Fit a negative binomial model (accounting for overdispersion)
nb_model <- glm.nb(Summary_Ct ~ predictor_variable, data = your_data)

# Perform a Likelihood Ratio Test (LRT)
lr_test <- lrtest(poisson_model, nb_model)

# Check the p-value of the test
p_value <- lr_test$`Pr(>Chisq)`

# If p-value is significant (typically < 0.05), it suggests overdispersion
if (p_value < 0.05) {
  cat("Overdispersion detected.")
} else {
  cat("No significant overdispersion.")
}

```


Pulling out dfs from the original data to plot these four separate areas that have the greatest sex difference in CS: 2:00, 8:00, 11:00 and 21:00.
```{r}
focus_all <- combined_data %>%
  mutate(Activity_Label = case_when(
    Time == "03:00" ~ "Midnight Snack",
    Time == "08:00" ~ "Morning Anxiety",
    Time == "12:00" ~ "Early Siesta",
    Time == "21:00" ~ "Peak Activity",
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  ),
  p_value = case_when(
    Time == "03:00" ~ 1.373282e-59,
    Time == "08:00" ~ 7.965520e-83,
    Time == "12:00" ~ 1.237893e-120,
    Time == "21:00" ~ 1.466501e-32,
    TRUE ~ NA_real_
  ))
focus_all$Activity_Label<-factor(focus_all$Activity_Label,
      levels=c("Morning Anxiety","Early Siesta","Peak Activity","Midnight Snack","Other"))

focus_areas <- avg_counts_by_tube %>%
  mutate(Activity_Label = case_when(
    Time == "03:00" ~ "Midnight Snack",
    Time == "08:00" ~ "Morning Anxiety",
    Time == "12:00" ~ "Early Siesta",
    Time == "21:00" ~ "Peak Activity",
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  ),
  p_value = case_when(
    Time == "03:00" ~ 1.373282e-59,
    Time == "08:00" ~ 7.965520e-83,
    Time == "12:00" ~ 1.237893e-120,
    Time == "21:00" ~ 1.466501e-32,
    TRUE ~ NA_real_
  ))
focus_areas$Activity_Label<-factor(focus_areas$Activity_Label,
      levels=c("Morning Anxiety","Early Siesta","Peak Activity","Midnight Snack","Other"))

focus_areas2 <- avg_counts_by_Experiment %>%
  mutate(Activity_Label = case_when(
    Time == "03:00" ~ "Midnight Snack",
    Time == "08:00" ~ "Morning Anxiety",
    Time == "12:00" ~ "Early Siesta",
    Time == "21:00" ~ "Peak Activity",
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  ),
  p_value = case_when(
    Time == "03:00" ~ 1.373282e-59,
    Time == "08:00" ~ 7.965520e-83,
    Time == "12:00" ~ 1.237893e-120,
    Time == "21:00" ~ 1.466501e-32,
    TRUE ~ NA_real_
  ))
focus_areas2$Activity_Label<-factor(focus_areas2$Activity_Label,
      levels=c("Morning Anxiety","Early Siesta","Peak Activity","Midnight Snack","Other"))

```
Plotting each time section as violin plots w/ corrected pvalues
```{r}
# Create the plot with p-value annotations
ggplot(focus_all, aes(x = Sex, y = Summary_Ct, fill = Sex, group = Sex)) +
  geom_violin() +
  geom_point() +
  labs(x = "Sex", y = "Activity Counts", title = "CS Activity Differences by Time and Sex - All data points") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("M" = "purple", "F" = "orange")) +
  theme_classic() +
  facet_grid(~Activity_Label) +
  geom_text(data = focus_all, aes(x = "M", y = max(Summary_Ct) + 20, label = ifelse(p_value < 0.00001, "<0.00001", sprintf("%.3f", p_value))), size = 3.5) +
  theme(plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0))  # Move caption to the left

ggplot(focus_areas, aes(x = Sex, y = tube_mean, fill = Sex, group = Sex)) +
  geom_violin() +
  geom_point() +
  labs(x = "Sex", y = "Activity Counts", title = "CS Activity Differences by Time and Sex - All averaged data points") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("M" = "purple", "F" = "orange")) +
  theme_classic() +
  facet_grid(~Activity_Label) +
  geom_text(data = focus_areas, aes(x = "M", y = 500, label = ifelse(p_value < 0.001, "<0.001", sprintf("%.3f", p_value))), size = 3.5) +
  theme(plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0))  # Move caption to the left

ggplot(focus_areas2, aes(x = Sex, y = experiment_mean, fill = Sex, group = Sex)) +
  geom_violin() +
  geom_point() +
  labs(x = "Sex", y = "Activity Counts", title = "CS Activity Differences by Time and Sex - Experimental Means") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("M" = "purple", "F" = "orange")) +
  theme_classic() +
  facet_grid(~Activity_Label) +
  geom_text(data = focus_areas2, aes(x = "M", y = max(experiment_mean) + 20, label = ifelse(p_value < 0.00001, "<0.00001", sprintf("%.3f", p_value))), size = 3.5) +
  theme(plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0))  # Move caption to the left
```
